title: 度量埋点

ddl.ddl: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS r27_thread_cpu(session_id TEXT NOT NULL,thread_name TEXT NOT NULL,cpu_ms INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,wall_ms INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,slices INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(session_id,thread_name))
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS r27_task_error(error_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,task_id TEXT NOT NULL,error_class TEXT NOT NULL,message TEXT NOT NULL,stack TEXT NOT NULL,recorded_at INTEGER NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS r26_task(task_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,lane TEXT NOT NULL,mechanism TEXT NOT NULL,snapshot_hash TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',cursor INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,fence INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,lease_until INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,owner TEXT,status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'READY',blocked_reason TEXT,next_at INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,last_progress INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,steps INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,last_cpu_ms INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)
